channel.title: QUAD Academy Blog
channel.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths and Science board-exam prep from QUAD Academy.

item.title: Arithmetic Progressions Class 10: 8 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Maths Chapter 5, nth Term and Sum of n Terms)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 5 solved: the nth term, which term is a given number, the nth term from the end, finding k for three terms in AP, the sum of n terms, the two-answer "how many terms" question, finding the nth term from Sn, and the cash-prize word problem.

item.title: Quadratic Equations Class 10: 8 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Maths Chapter 4, Discriminant and Word Problems)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 4 solved: finding k when a root is given, equal roots, the discriminant and nature of roots, factorisation with surds, the quadratic formula, and the consecutive-integer and train-speed word problems.

item.title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables Class 10: 8 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Maths Chapter 3)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 3 solved: the a1/a2, b1/b2, c1/c2 ratio test for unique, no and infinitely many solutions, substitution, elimination, and the age, fraction and taxi-fare word problems.

item.title: Real Numbers Class 10: 8 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Maths Chapter 1, HCF, LCM and Irrational Proofs)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 1 solved: LCM and HCF by prime factorisation, remainder and co-prime traps, HCF × LCM, bells and ruler word problems, and the √5 and 2 + 3√3 irrational proofs.

item.title: Polynomials Class 10: 8 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Maths Chapter 2, Sum and Product of Zeroes)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 2 solved: sum and product of zeroes, finding p from a condition, reciprocal zeroes, alpha-beta expressions, building a polynomial from its zeroes and the arch case study, with the trap in each question.

item.title: Our Environment Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 13, 10% Law and Biomagnification)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 13 solved: biodegradable vs non-biodegradable, the 10 percent law, energy at each trophic level, biological magnification, decomposers and the ozone layer, with the trap in each question.

item.title: Human Eye and the Colourful World Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 10, Myopia and Hypermetropia)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 10 solved: presbyopia, hypermetropia and myopia with the right corrective lens, power of accommodation, deviation through a prism and scattering of light, with the trap in each question.

item.title: Metals and Non-metals Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 3, Reactivity Series)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 3 solved: metals with water and acids, the reactivity series, displacement in salt solutions, alloys, extraction and the ionic bond in MgO, with the trap in each question.

item.title: Light Reflection and Refraction Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 9, Mirror and Lens Formula)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 9 solved: convex and concave lens numericals, negative magnification, refractive index and speed of light, and the rear-view mirror, with the sign-convention trap in each.

item.title: Acids, Bases and Salts Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 2, pH and Litmus)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 2 solved: litmus, baking powder, nature of salts, CuO + HCl, the pH case study, Plaster of Paris and three give-reasons questions, with the trap in each.

item.title: Heredity Class 10: 7 Must-Do Board Questions, Solved (CBSE Science Chapter 8, Punnett Squares)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 8 Heredity solved: monohybrid and dihybrid Punnett squares, 1:2:1 and 9:3:3:1 ratios, inherited vs acquired traits, and sex determination (44 + XY).

item.title: How Do Organisms Reproduce: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 7)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 7 solved: DNA copying and variation, fission, budding, regeneration, spores, vegetative propagation, flowers, pollination, human reproduction and health.

item.title: Control and Coordination: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 6)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 6 solved: neuron and synapse, reflex arc, parts of the brain, plant movements and tropisms, plant hormones, endocrine glands and feedback.

item.title: Life Processes: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 5)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 5 solved: photosynthesis, stomata, digestion enzymes, aerobic vs anaerobic respiration, double circulation, xylem and phloem, and the nephron.

item.title: Carbon and its Compounds: 7 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 4)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 4 solved: homologous series, soap micelles, isomers, conductivity, glacial acetic acid, identify-the-compound and why carbon shares electrons.

item.title: Coordinate Geometry: 6 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 7)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 7 solved: distance formula, equidistant points, proving a square, section formula, ratio from an axis and the parallelogram trick, with marking tips.

item.title: Introduction to Trigonometry: 5 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 8)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 8 solved: one ratio to all six, standard-angle values, finding A and B, and identity proofs, with marking tips and common traps.

item.title: Heights and Distances: 4 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 9)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Maths Chapter 9 Some Applications of Trigonometry solved: kite string, walking towards a tower, two ships from a lighthouse, building and tower.

item.title: How to Use Previous-Year Questions the Smart Way (Class 10)
item.description: A seven-step method for using CBSE Class 10 previous-year questions properly: sort by type, pause and try, mark mistakes in three colours, keep an error list and practise under time.

item.title: Chemical Reactions and Equations: 3 Board Question Types, Solved (CBSE Class 10 Science)
item.description: CBSE Class 10 Science Chapter 1 board questions solved step by step: heating lead nitrate, the barium chloride precipitation reaction, and the oxidising-agent trap, with marking tips.
